description: Defines an interface for condition variables in the Starboard platform, including creation, destruction, waiting, signaling, and broadcasting operations.

methods.name: SbConditionVariableCreate
methods.description: Creates a new condition variable, optionally associating it with a mutex.

methods.name: SbConditionVariableWait
methods.description: Waits indefinitely on a condition variable.

methods.name: SbConditionVariableWaitTimed
methods.description: Waits on a condition variable with a timeout.

methods.name: SbConditionVariableBroadcast
methods.description: Wakes all threads waiting on the condition variable.

methods.name: SbConditionVariableSignal
methods.description: Wakes a single thread waiting on the condition variable.
